scope: Independent numerical and visual review of five 65x65x65 display-sRGB CUBE LUTs. Native PF3 interpretation, camera registration/output, physical film accuracy and source-engine correctness are not established by this review.

method.cube_parser: Independent reader, red-fastest CUBE traversal verified by grid-node interpolation.
method.neutral_cast_space: CIELAB D65 computed from encoded sRGB; C*ab is diagnostic neutral cast, not error against physical film.
method.pairwise_metric: CIE76 distance between different LUT outputs; measures separation, not accuracy against film.
method.photo_metrics: Images reduced to at most 640 pixels with Lanczos; encoded sRGB retained. Counts are diagnostics of these supplied images, not representative population estimates.

numerical_acceptance_criteria.finite_domain: All delivered nodes finite and within [0,1].
numerical_acceptance_criteria.gray_highlights: Strictly positive mean response derivative over input [0.9,1]; no repeated terminal intervals.
numerical_acceptance_criteria.shaper: Strictly increasing internal coordinate, wholly inside declared internal model domain.
numerical_acceptance_criteria.neutral_cast: Residual channel spread below 0.00011 on 8193 sampled neutral points.
numerical_acceptance_criteria.monochrome_tolerance: Tri-X maximum RGB channel spread less than 1e-6 over all delivered nodes.
numerical_acceptance_criteria.hash: SHA-256 equals the current reviewed bake manifest.
numerical_acceptance_criteria.interpolation: Identity interpolation within 1e-14; 1000 exact grid-node samples within 1e-12.

method.neutral_cast_threshold_note: The residual-channel threshold is a numerical check on the declared balanced-positive rendition, not a physical film accuracy criterion.

visual_assessment.summary: Useful skin and fabric gradation, balanced neutrals and a gently richer warm rendition. The coffee and landscape preserve colour transitions after gamut compression.
observations: Warmer and more colourful than the original JPEG in these examples, while gentler than Gold/Ektar.
Only one portrait complexion and lighting case is available.

visual_assessment.summary: A distinct, warmer and livelier colour option. Coffee reds and wood retain gradation rather than the earlier hard channel-floor clipping.
observations: Colour remains deliberately stronger than Portra/Pro 400H; no additional warming or saturation stage is recommended.
The previously flagged coffee effective 8-bit channel-black fraction has fallen from 22.575% to zero in the same reduced-input test.

visual_assessment.summary: The strongest vivid colour rendition, with distinct reds, foliage and blue/cyan skies. The earlier coffee and landscape channel-floor clipping is resolved.
observations: Still stronger in colour and tone than the other colour stocks, consistent with the intended vivid option.
Coffee effective 8-bit channel-black fraction has fallen from 29.823% to zero; landscape has fallen from 14.474% to zero in the same reduced-input test.

visual_assessment.summary: A calmer colour rendition with convincingly neutral fabric and whites. The earlier cool-shadow/warm-highlight crossover has been removed without collapsing its distinction from the other stocks.
observations: Maximum sampled neutral RGB spread is approximately 0.000020762, and maximum sampled neutral C*ab is below 0.003.
Neutral balance is the project's declared positive-timing choice, not a measured property of every physical Pro 400H scan.

visual_assessment.summary: A coherent monochrome rendition with preserved shadow, midtone and highlight gradation, and no visible residual tint.
observations: Maximum RGB spread over all delivered nodes is approximately 2.4e-7, far below an 8-bit or 12-bit code step.
The LUT contains tone and colour-to-brightness response; grain, adjacency and halation remain outside its scope.

visual_review.comparison: Identical inputs through independent tetrahedral interpolation, reviewed as all-scenes and larger camera-landscape sheets. Published Portra and overview sheets were also inspected.
visual_review.colour_stock_separation: All six pairs among the four colour looks remain numerically distinct. Uniform-RGB median CIE76 output differences range from 4.073 (Gold/Ektar) to 10.680 (Ektar/Pro400H); photographic medians vary with scene. These are between-look differences, not accuracy scores.
visual_review.clipping: No delivered grid node reaches the reviewed exact low/high clipping thresholds. No sampled supplied-photo output reaches an effective 8-bit channel black or white in the reduced-input tests. This describes these floating-point LUT applications; JPEG encoding can add small code changes.
visual_review.physical_reference_policy: Earlier primary-source Kodak/Fujifilm material descriptions supplied qualitative context. No brochure image or film scan was used as pixel ground truth.

limitations: No physical G7 X III/film chart pair, scanner calibration or measured-film accuracy score is available.
The CUBE hashes identify exactly the assets reviewed. Re-baked assets require a new review.

This review does not compare held-out points against a newly evaluated source engine; it verifies the delivered tables, shaper receipts and their application to supplied photographs. Source-model holdout checks are separate.
Order invariance here checks only delivered pointwise LUT application. It does not independently prove that the original engine bake excluded all spatial effects.
Neutral-ramp positivity does not establish perceptual smoothness of every possible hue trajectory.
Photo statistics use reduced, already processed digital images and are not a camera population study.
A single supplied portrait does not establish accuracy across complexions or illuminants.
Native Canon software renders and PF3 fitting have separate evidence in research/canon-native-validation.json. No camera installation or out-of-camera JPEG was tested in this review.

overall_result.summary: The final five CUBEs are finite, bounded, hash-matched and free of neutral highlight plateaus. Neutral crossover and severe channel-floor clipping from the earlier revision are resolved. The four colour renditions remain distinct, and Tri-X is effectively achromatic. Supplied photos are visually plausible as film-inspired looks; this is not a measured film/scanner match.

final_rendering_choices.display_adaptation: Fixed inverse gray-ramp pre-shaper; per-stock input/stock-ramp shares and black/white targets recorded in bake manifest and shaper JSON. Internal calibration exposure [0,2]; public encoded-sRGB [0,1].
final_rendering_choices.linear_delivery: Luminance-axis chroma compression in linear sRGB before clipping, normalized gamut-distance knee 0.80 and asymptotic ceiling 0.985. This preserves linear chroma direction, not necessarily perceptual hue.
final_rendering_choices.neutral_positive_timing: Subtract the model gray crossover at the encoded mean output brightness, then softly contain colour distance in encoded RGB (knee 0.90, ceiling 0.995). Fixed model lookup; no per-image metering.
final_rendering_choices.authorship: These are authored delivery/positive decisions, not new manufacturer measurements or paired-film fitting.

published_example_checks.interpretation: Sampled released JPEG pixels are consistent with independently applying the current CUBEs, allowing for JPEG compression and quantisation. Hash checks identify the exact published files.
